verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

Say to the Ammonites, 'Listen to the message of the Lord GOD! This is what the Lord GOD says: You said "Aha!" when my holy place was dishonored, when the land of Israel was ruined, and when the people of Judah went into exile.
So I am going to hand you over to the people of the east as their possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.
I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and the land of Ammon into a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: You clapped your hands and stamped your feet, celebrating with all the scorn in your heart against the land of Israel.

So I will stretch out my hand against you and hand you over as loot to the nations. I will cut you off from the peoples and wipe you out from among the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.'
This is what the Lord GOD says: 'Moab and Seir said, "Look, the people of Judah are just like all the other nations."
So I will open up Moab's flank, starting with its border towns, the glory of the land: Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim.
I will hand Moab, along with the Ammonites, over to the people of the east as their possession, so that the Ammonites will no longer be remembered among the nations.
I will punish Moab, and they will know that I am the LORD.'
This is what the Lord GOD says: 'Edom took revenge on the people of Judah and became very guilty by doing so.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and wipe out its people and animals. I will make it a wasteland from Teman to Dedan, and they will die by the sword.
I will take revenge on Edom through my people Israel. They will deal with Edom according to my anger and fury. Then the Edomites will know what my revenge is like, says the Lord GOD.'
This is what the Lord GOD says: 'The Philistines took revenge and got even with scorn in their hearts. Their hatred never ended, and they wanted to destroy.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to stretch out my hand against the Philistines. I will cut off the Kerethites and destroy those who are left along the coast.
I will take great revenge on them and punish them in my fury. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I take revenge on them.'"
